name.ja: BB戦士137 鉄斗羅頑駄無

description.ja: • 新世大将軍の光の力で改心し闇軍団から足を洗った抜け忍。
description.en: • A ninja who changed his mind and left the Dark Army with the power of light from the New World General.

description.ja: • 軽装タイプ、通常形態、頑駄無形態、闇の力開放形態と各形態を再現可能。
description.en: • Each form can be reproduced: light armored type, normal form, gunless form, dark power release form.

description.ja: • BB戦士No.126武者飛駆鳥の鉄鋼迦楼羅と合体。
description.en: • Combined with BB Senshi No.126 Musha Asukacho's Tekko Karura.

description.ja: • BB戦士No.57、60、64、65の闇将軍の闇の鎧や、BB戦士No.130の大鋼も装着可能。
description.en: • The dark armor of the dark generals of BB Senshi No. 57, 60, 64, and 65 and the large steel of BB Senshi No. 130 can also be installed.
